sourceContext.originPage: Momentum model page (template "model", 23 RV model pages)

visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: mixed: side image, full-width banner, background photo, logo/icon rows
notes: Panel layout chosen from content: images only = banner; standalone image before text = split; standalone image after text = overlay; text only = text
A paragraph or list holding 2+ images renders as an icon row
Tab bar is not rendered when there is a single tab

contentPattern.structure: one row per feature (1-10). Cell 1: tab label. Cell 2: free-form content (images, heading, paragraphs, lists, links). Put a standalone image first for image-beside-text, last for text-over-background-photo, alone for a full-width banner; put several logos/icons in one paragraph or list for an icon row
